Armand did not retreat with the Bloomville villagers.
He was the First Lethal Thorn of the Seven Lethal Thorns! How could he abandon Princess Melloblum?
But he could only watch, helpless, as his companions fell one by one in the onslaught. He hated how powerless he was.
It was then that Princess Melloblum said to him, "Armand, rest now, you’ve done well."
He watched as Princess Melloblum performed that familiar Dance of Blissful Bloom.
The dance gave the Budsquires enough strength to retreat into the Maze of Thorns.
